d:
This quick total body routine helps release stiffness, wake up your muscles, and reset your energy when your body feels heavy, tight, or disconnected. In just 7 minutes, you’ll move through simple but effective patterns that improve mobility, circulation, strength, and focus all at once.
No wasted time. No overcomplicated sequencing. Just intentional movement that leaves you feeling lighter, clearer, and more alive in your body by the end.
